title: Man’s heart stops and he learns to ride light waves through the universe
content:
I was on my bed. I was done eating but something in my body felt out of place. I lay down to realize that there is food inside my lungs and my body was convulsing in order to counteract the circumstances and prevail to save the lungs.

I started to feel cold, feel a chill in my side, my hands, arms, legs and fingers, as if something of a vital fluid was unable to pulse with the reciprocating brain input.

I started to feel intensely uncomfortable. Then I felt my heart or something in my chest in correlation with my eye, my right eye, and then I look at my reflection to wonder what was the current situation. After I then looked at myself laying on my bed, I thought something was wrong, telling from the instant cease of motor functionality in 1/3 of my body as well as a numbing pain and draining feeling. All heat was leaving my body as I became very cold, as I twitched.

After that, I looked at my reflection in the window and knew something was about to happen, something bad. I was in pure agony, a pain in my neck which was comparable to trying to fight the ocean with a sandcastle. It felt like I was getting looser, less tight, and the pain went numb and my muscles went limp and very weak.

I then face-planted into my pillow, then felt my heartbeat as soon as I hit the pillow. It stopped and then my eyes’ vision went dark, but it was like curtains closed from all directions as I was immediately doused into a world I'd never seen. The whole universe.

I was pushed away from the sun and then I was scrambling to find some way I could come back to Earth. Everywhere were lines, horizontal and vertical, all linear with golden light pumping through them incredibly fast.

I found out how to ride the light and then I rode it back to Earth. When I returned, I was entranced by how I learned to move around this new world. Glorious it was to feel, just to do.

I flew around earth many times, playing with gravity and flying above so fast like green lantern. Then a flash of light interrupted me, in the form of a person made up of black dark energy, surrounded by an aura of ribbons of light that faded back into the place around them.

I saw them as I was in a cloud clearing above earth. Stars above clouds of many colors had surrounded me and this mysterious person.

They held their hand out as if to stop a car and then they said, "No, this shouldn't have happened to you."

I instantaneously knew what they had meant. Then another bright flash of light brought us into my bedroom.

They proceeded to say, "You are going to breathe life into yourself even though you are dead." I didn't say anything. I didn't know how and plus they'd know since I just arrived to the other side, or at least one of them, as I know now our reality is a fraction of what we should really see and experience.

They proceeded to teach me how to connect waves together instinctively and then I started to harness this angry mass of microwaves or some form of wave science and then I pushed it into my spine as my body began to jerk back to life, like jumpstarting a car.

Everything went black. Then I remember from a golden place of lines and light, golden and yellow white light lines, I was shoved back into my eyes like I was pulled inside of them, literally pushed into my eyes, like I was pushed out of a door, slammed back in.

I tried to scream, having reclaimed my body. I couldn't. There was no air in my lungs. I gasped to get up, absolutely flabbergasted and I didn't even recognize my own room, as the first thing I literally said was, “What... What? Whose house is this?"

I came back here from there, with gifts from the other side and things having never been known until one sees for themselves.

I started to breathe and then I reclaimed myself. I saw things I never realized in myself... I saw things I knew but from so many different angles and perspectives. It was enlightenment to say the least.

A new lease on life for certain. Certainly, we are blind though we see, where they sit to watch us fight, as they wait to see a better world, like me.

The other side was gorgeous, all the music and people and places. It was literally beyond heaven. The most beautiful thing I ever witnessed was when I was dead.

I want you to know that we are beyond matter, that matter is only waves on higher dimensional scales, particles included.
